No finite sample is used to infer an infinite-domain theorem.

value.rationale: The finite-system result is a completely site-resolved violation of uniform-field monotonicity: all five originally favoured sites lose favoured colour and all seven others gain it at the unique first positive threshold. The graph is a standard smallest-order cubic identity example, and uniqueness of its maximum independent set provides an explanatory structural mechanism. Sharp field windows, counts and boundary coexistence have useful precise mathematical meaning; no general all-graph or thermodynamic assertion is made.
